Name: CAMERA_FADE_PARAM_ST
Description: Camera fade: models close to the camera fade out so they don't block the view. Distances are from the camera to the model, in metres: fully opaque beyond Far Fade: Start Distance, fading to Semi-Transparent Alpha by Far Fade: Semi-Transparent Distance, held until Near Fade: Start Distance, then fading to invisible at Near Fade: Invisible Distance.

Fields.Name: Near Fade: Invisible Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance at or below which the model is fully invisible (alpha 0). In metres.

Fields.Name: Near Fade: Start Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance where the near fade starts: alpha falls from Semi-Transparent Alpha here to 0 at Near Fade: Invisible Distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Far Fade: Semi-Transparent Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance where the far fade ends: the model reaches Semi-Transparent Alpha here and stays at it until Near Fade: Start Distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Far Fade: Start Distance
Fields.Description: Camera distance where fading begins; beyond it the model is fully opaque (alpha 1). In metres.

Fields.Name: Semi-Transparent Alpha
Fields.Description: Opacity (0-1) held between the far and near fades. 1: no far fade, only the near fade to invisible.
